title: Rav Assi bar Abba, Who Reports Rabbi Yochanan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 39b according to the Rif’s reading. Hyman suggests that possibly this is what Yuchasin meant in citing Rav Ashi bar Abba reporting Rabbi Yochanan; he considers it undoubtedly his reading in Yevamot there. The reading Hyman uses is “Rami [bar] Chama said that Rabbi Yitzchak said” (supplied רמי רב חמא), and the Rosh reads Rami bar Abba.

notes.text: The supplied רמי רב חמא is represented as Rami bar Chama, one person, in this connected transmission. Hyman’s proposed identities, his certainty about the reading and the Assi/Ashi forms remain his claims; the digital evidence does not establish a printing history.
